params.name: page
params.description: Page index of the results to return. First page is 0.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results per page.  There is a maximum of 1000 results allowed from this endpoint.

params.name: include_totals
params.description: Return results inside an object that contains the total result count (true) or as a direct array of results (false, default).

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include or exclude (based on value provided for include_fields) in the result. Leave empty to retrieve all fields.

params.name: include_fields
params.description: Whether specified fields are to be included (true) or excluded (false).

params.name: user_id
params.description: user_id of the devices to retrieve.

params.name: client_id
params.description: client_id of the devices to retrieve.

params.name: type
params.description: Type of credentials to retrieve. Must be `public_key`, `refresh_token` or `rotating_refresh_token`. The property will default to `refresh_token` when paging is requested

items.docs: Retrieve device credential information (public_key, refresh_token, or rotating_refresh_token) associated with a specific user.

info.name: Create a Device Public Key Credential

items.docs: Create a device credential public key to manage refresh token rotation for a given user_id. Device Credentials APIs are designed for ad-hoc administrative use only and paging is by default enabled for GET requests. When refresh token rotation is enabled, the endpoint becomes consistent. For more information, read Signing Keys.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the credential to delete.

items.docs: Permanently delete a device credential (such as a refresh token or public key) with the given ID.
